title: East Coast hotel block is up
body: Stars Nationals — Walker rooms for Pennsville (Oct 23–25) are on the weekend kit. Stay-to-play — book the team link.

title: Fall schedule is locked in
body: Dates on the calendar are game days. Arrive the night before unless the event says you can drive in that morning. East Coast hotel block is posted; the rest of the weekends when the holds land.

title: Order the white pinstripes
body: Fall 2026 we added white pinstripe jerseys. If you don't have them yet, order them before the first tournament. GroupMe is still the team channel — this page is the written record so nobody has to scroll back for the call.
